title: Seasonal Pit Firing (Ongoing)
bring: bisque-fired pots and dried organic materials
cost_text: Sliding scale available; scholarships available by emailing ceramics@artillery-ag.com
summary: Artillery AG offers seasonal pit firing gatherings where participants bring bisque-fired work and dried organic materials. Pieces are fired in a hand-built outdoor pit with wood, organic materials, and minerals. Work to bring includes bisque-fired pots and optional organic materials like coffee grounds, eggshells, or seaweed.
source_quote: Pit firing is one of the oldest ceramic firing methods, rooted in ancestral knowledge and communal making. Work is fired outdoors in a hand-built pit, layered with wood, organic materials, and minerals.
evidence_sentence: The dedicated pit firing page describes seasonal pit firing gatherings using a hand-built outdoor pit where potters bring bisque-fired work.
evidence_quote: Work is fired outdoors in a hand-built pit, layered with wood, organic materials, and minerals.
